hook: Turn the focus knob. Pond life resolves and swims across the glass.
outcome: Explore physically scaled photographic specimens, prepare mounts, follow pond organisms, change focus through measured depth planes, and keep private observations.

sources.credit: Men Q-L, Starkevich P, Saldaitis A (2021)
sources.scale: Full available source (1512 x 1314 px): 2.0 mm bar measures 206 px, or 9.71 um/px. The 1420 px crop is 13.79 mm wide including background; this is not an anatomical wing length. Article reports 14.3-16.8 mm wing length for the species. Source resolution limits high-power use.

sources.title: Human epithelial cells stained with methylene blue dye
sources.scale: Approximate only: 0.22 um per original pixel, using a roughly 250-pixel cell edge and a 55 um reference size. Prasad et al. control cells average 54.97 um; Romeo et al. independently describe mature buccal cells as 50-60 um on edge. These are variable biological sizes, not a camera calibration. Do not use this slide for precision measurement; use the source-bar-scaled blood fields instead.
sources.magnification: Not stated by photographer; never used to invent a calibrated pixel size.

sources.credit: J. J. van Hellemond and coauthors; CDC Emerging Infectious Diseases (2009)
sources.scale: Caption: 5 µm bar, approximately 28 pixels in this 600 px figure. Eight Giemsa-stained blood fields with malaria parasites. The uninfected cell near source x105,y50 spans about 42 pixels, independently approximately 7.5 µm.

sources.title: High-contrast multifocus microscopy with a single camera and z-splitter prism, Supplement 1, Fig. S9b
sources.credit: Sheng Xiao, Howard Gritton, Hua-an Tseng, Dana Zemel, Xue Han, Jerome Mertz (2020)
sources.scale: 100 µm bar = approximately 98 pixels in extracted PDF JPEG. Nine simultaneous focal planes spaced 25 µm, +100 to -100 µm. Fixed Volvox in Eukitt; darkfield, original ImageJ green-fire-blue lookup table retained. Same registered crop for every plane.

sources.title: CIL:43552, Allium cepa, root tip
sources.scale: Approximate 0.22 um per pixel: nuclei around 80-110 pixels compared with roughly 18-24 um nuclei in the independently scaled Cavusoglu control fields. Archive supplies no pixel calibration. This is a size-based inference, unsuitable for precision measurement.

limitations: Finite photographic fields; high zoom does not create new source detail.
Animated pond paths; no recorded ciliary motion.
Water, coverslip, air and oil are optical models; staining does not change source chemistry.
Hair scale inferred from a known grid; source darkfield/reflected-light contrast retained where declared.
Prepared cheek field scale is inferred from variable biological size, not camera-calibrated. Use the source-bar-scaled blood fields for measurement.
Broad contiguous root/blood/onion fields and resolved wing hairs remain unavailable. No gate pass is claimed.
